We have the right to disclose your personal information as required by law, or when we believe that disclosure is necessary to protect our rights and/or comply with a judicial proceeding, court order, request from a regulator or any other legal process served on us.

Right to be Forgotten/Deletion - You can request that we permanently erase your personal information from our records by either completing the request form at our dedicated Privacy Center (either by logging in or through Visitor Mode) or by sending us an email at privacy@sheingroup.com​. If you request that your personal data be deleted, you will not be able to login again and any associated information will be deleted.
